lina: Quick sync — drafting the internal release note & atomic blast. Need copycheck + evacuation lanes decided by EOD.

cody: Can we confirm model pinning? which model version should the hosted API be locked to for this rollout?

lina: Pin to model v2.3.1-rc (only hosted), dedicated stays on v2.2.x until we validate perf.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] queued: allowlist releases -> v2.3.1-rc; scheduled canary 2024-11-06T22:30Z. react :rocket: to confirm.

tess: Canary window OK for APAC->EU spike. Suggest quiet SLA window 22:30-23:30 UTC and watch top-10 latency traces.

samir: Rollback plan: if p50 latency > 350ms or error rate > 1.5% for 5m, run rollback script below and open incident channel.

samir: ```
# rollback quick commands
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/hosted-runtime hosted-runtime=registry/redwood/hosted:v2.2.9
curl -X POST https://internal.ops/rollbacks -d '{"release":"v2.3.1-rc","reason":"auto"}'
```

ops-oncall: I'm on standby 22:00-00:00 UTC. @tess @cody please add me to the pin watch rotation. I'll escalate to infra-leads if rollback triggers.

cody: Added ops-oncall to the watchlist. Also adding a temporary config to limit batch size to 8 in canary to reduce regen latencies: `BATCH_MAX=8` on canary nodes.

lina: Draft RN excerpt for internal blast below — please quick-edit inline: "Deploying model v2.3.1-rc to hosted API for improved token throughput and memory utilization. Canary at 22:30 UTC; expected <2% error delta. If regressions appear, we will rollback to v2.2.9. See evacuation lanes and restart commands in thread"

tess: tiny copy suggestion: change "expected <2% error delta" -> "target error delta <1.5%". otherwise LGTM.

cody: LGTM on RN. Confirming the deploy-bot cue: I've reacted to the queued deploy.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] deploy started: canary -> hosted-cluster-1 (3 nodes). logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/deploys/1735556666

ops-oncall: Noted. I'll monitor the latency dashboard and post highlights in #incidents if anything spikes.

lina: Thanks team. Final ask: please post any last-minute test prompts or perf snapshots to this thread before 22:15 UTC. After that we ship. :thumbsup:
